title: On-demand daily standup report
description:
## Origin

Discord 2026-09-09 (frendan_braser / Ryan). Need an adaptive on-demand standup they can speak from — not paragraphs.

## Output profiles

Two distinct report outputs from the same underlying board data:

1. **Meeting script** — first-person standup the user can speak from aloud.
2. **Director brief** — stakeholder scan summarizing project health, risks, and momentum.

Both profiles consume `kbs now` output only after JIT fail-closed real summaries are in place (Epic kbs-0fe175). No placeholder or mock right-now text may feed report generation.

## Shape

Daily standup with standard questions:

- What I did yesterday
- What I am doing today
- Blockers

Plus likely questions they might get asked. Written like the user might speak; very short bullets (Meeting script). Director brief uses the same data with executive framing.

## Data sources

Consume Kanbus (and optionally Jira-synced) issues, right-now summaries, and recursive rollups via `kbs now` after JIT fail-closed generation. Shared AI stack with right-now regeneration — one pipeline, not a parallel mock path.

## Delivery

On demand (CLI + later console). Ship JIT fail-closed `kbs now` first (kbs-0fe175); standup report generation follows once real summaries are reliable.

## Architecture

Kanbus AI procedures share the right-now stack; Tactus DSL orchestration comes later (see Epic kbs-e7abbe). Do not fork a separate LLM path for standup until the shared stack is proven.

## Scope boundary

Do not implement report generation until child epics exist and JIT fail-closed `kbs now` ships.
